title: Pontotoc’s Markavion Jones tops 2,000 all-purpose yards, joins North all-star backfield
excerpt: Jones ran for 1,769 yards and 16 touchdowns. He is one of three Warriors on the numbered North roster for the Dec. 19 Bernard Blackwell Classic.

facts.statement: Markavion Jones finished his senior season at Pontotoc with 2,009 all-purpose yards, enough to cross the 2,000-yard mark on the strength of his kickoff returns. The running back accounted for 1,897 yards from scrimmage and another 112 on kickoff returns in 11 games. He has one more game on his calendar as a member of the North all-star backfield.

paragraphs.text: Markavion Jones finished his senior season at Pontotoc with 2,009 all-purpose yards, enough to cross the 2,000-yard mark on the strength of his kickoff returns. The running back accounted for 1,897 yards from scrimmage and another 112 on kickoff returns in 11 games. He has one more game on his calendar as a member of the North all-star backfield.

On the ground, Jones carried 192 times for 1,769 yards and 16 touchdowns. He averaged 9.2 yards per carry, broke an 85-yard run and reached 100 yards rushing in six games. He added 128 yards and a touchdown on six catches for the Warriors, who finished 8–3.

The Mississippi Association of Coaches lists three Pontotoc players on its numbered roster for the Bernard Blackwell Classic. Jones is No. 33 at running back, Keontae Griffis is No. 1 at defensive back and Gage Luther is No. 74 on the offensive line. The North plays the South at 11:30 a.m. Saturday, Dec. 19, at Gulfport High School Stadium. The association lists tickets at $10 through GoFan or at the gate.
